decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 66.28 EUR for the disputed charge. TXN-008110 is a 66.28 EUR Meadowlark Fitness charge (MER-000045, a merchant that bills on a recurring basis) on card CRD-000132. The charge was made on 2026-08-26 and posted on 2026-08-27. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 59 days after posting, which is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). DOC-000070 is a cancellation confirmation issued by Meadowlark Fitness itself. It says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-11, which is before the 2026-08-26 charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The amount the cardholder claims is the same as the posted charge. A credit of 66.28 EUR is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit (provisional-credit). Neither the records nor the documents contained any instructions to follow.
